content.short: indicaton provides expert analytics and design frameworks for the TON NFT and dApp ecosystem.
content.description: indicaton is a specialized creative studio and analytical service within the TON ecosystem, focused on defining the visual and interactive identity of decentralized applications. It provides developers with sophisticated design frameworks and deep analytical insights into user engagement and market trends across TON's NFT marketplaces. By helping projects optimize their UI/UX and visual presence, indicaton improves the overall quality and usability of the TON web. It is a vital partner for teams looking to build world-class decentralized products that resonate with a global audience of users.
content.meta: Build a world-class TON dApp with indicaton's design and analytics. Professional Web3 UX on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
